I have enough to decide.

**Analysis:**
- Princes Pass holds a single Martell footman (id 27) with a March +0. It contributes 0 castle areas, and with 0 power I cannot leave a control token, so staying put yields nothing new.
- Two reachable undefended castles gain +1 castle area without combat: **Starfall** (castle=1, supply=1) and **Yronwood** (castle=1, no supply).
- Both destinations are empty (no units, no control token, no neutral force). Starfall's neighbours are all friendly/empty (Salt Shore mine, East/West Summer Sea empty, Princes Pass, Yronwood), so no combat risk.
- Key tiebreaker: taking Starfall gains a supply icon, exactly offsetting the supply icon I lose by vacating Princes Pass — my controlled supply icons stay at 3. Taking Yronwood gains no supply icon, dropping me to 2 supply icons, which would shrink permitted army sizes at the next Supply card. Yronwood also borders Baratheon's The Boneway (a march threat), while Starfall sits behind my own Salt Shore.
- So Starfall is the strictly better grab: same castle gain, better supply retention, safer position. Yronwood remains reachable later from Sunspear/Sea of Dorne.

**Intended action:** Resolve the Prince's Pass March +0 by moving footman 27 to **Starfall**, capturing that castle area without combat. No unit stays in Prince's Pass (unavoidable — no power for a control token), which is acceptable since it holds no castle. Result: Martell castle areas go from 1 → 2, supply icons remain 3.

**Final action:** `{"moves":[{"destination_region_id":"starfall"}]}`

This resolves the Prince's Pass March +0, sending footman 27 into Starfall to claim its castle area (no combat), leaving no Martell unit in Prince's Pass.

arguments.note: Round 3, Martell. Take Starfall with the Princes Pass footman (castle + supply icon, offsets vacating Princes Pass; keeps supply icons at 3). Yronwood is a later, easy grab from Sunspear/Sea of Dorne. Keep Sunspear knight + Sea of Dorne ship as the support core. Preserve high house cards (Red Viper, Areo Hotah) for battles that matter. Watch Baratheon at The Boneway and Tyrell around Dornish Marches/Oldtown.

actionOutputSchema.description: You are resolving one of your March orders. You choose which remaining March area to resolve now. Choose which units move and their destinations. Units you omit remain in the source area; you may split an army across destinations, and a single unit can march on its own. An empty moves list removes this March order without moving anyone. Only one destination may start combat. Use the reachable destinations in actionGuidance and keep the resulting armies within Supply. Leaving a control token costs one available power token and preserves control of the source when you legally vacate it. Compare castles gained and lost, and count support around the destination battlefield before choosing an attack. Your final answer resolves this one order; another remaining order is a later decision.
